name: Dream Canvas VR: Drawing Studio
summary:
Escape into a peaceful forest art studio where your imagination takes center stage. Dream Canvas VR: Drawing Studio turns a blank canvas into a relaxing, hands-on creative space built for Meta Quest.

Pick up four colorful markers using natural motion-controller interaction. Your strokes respond to how close the marker tip is pressed to the canvas, giving every line a more expressive feel.
